title: NFL continues to rely on attorney Brad Karp, despite Jeffrey Epstein ties

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL continues to rely on attorney Brad Karp, despite Jeffrey Epstein ties
sources.description: Most of the NFL's Jeffrey Epstein-related conversation has focused on former Giants co-owner Steve Tisch, who has transferred his shares into a trust for his children but who continues to serve as chairman of the team's board of directors.
